name: Ragi Mudde with Sambar
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ⅓ cup (40 g) ragi (finger millet) flour
1 cup water and a pinch of salt
Sambar: ¼ cup toor dal, 1 cup mixed vegetables, 1 small tomato, 1 tbsp tamarind pulp, 1 tbsp sambar powder, ¼ tsp turmeric
Tadka: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp mustard seeds, 6 curry leaves, 1 dried chilli
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Pressure-cook the dal with turmeric and 1½ cups water for 4 whistles. Mash.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Simmer the vegetables, tomato, tamarind and sambar powder in 1 cup water for 10 minutes. Add the dal and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the tadka of mustard, curry leaves and chilli. Season with salt.
For the mudde, boil the water with salt, add the ragi flour in one go and stir vigorously on low heat for 4–5 minutes into a smooth dough.
Wet your hands, shape into 2 balls, and serve with the hot sambar.
note: A Karnataka staple. Ragi is among the richest plant sources of calcium.
